title: The Changes number rule checks numbers against the pull requests they cite, in any spelling
acceptance: A beat's numbers must be stated by the pull requests in its own refs (a beat that cites none states none); a picture's by the pull requests it cites; the title and drawn figures by an included one.

Numbers compare by exact value only: 22k, 22,000 and 22 thousand are one number; 1.50 is 1.5; 09 is 9; a unit never converts (1.5 s and 1,500 ms stay two numbers). Each loosening has a test of the refusal it still makes.
Numbers written in words (one to ninety-nine, hundred, thousand and million compounds, one and a half) are held to the rule; the one idiom not read, "one of", is stated and tested.

A day, month or year of the period passes only inside a date expression, never as a count: 30 percent in a week ending 30 October is refused, 30 October passes. Versions (v2, 2.1.287) are whole tokens.

The seven published digests are checked under the new rule with their own included pull requests and any refusal is reported to the owner, not hidden; docs/plans/RISE-CHANGES.md states the rule with its motivating cases.

evidence.note: Branch changes/number-rule, local (Windows, not pushed). Red first on origin/main's admit.js: 10 failed of 68 (scope, 22k, trailing and leading zeros, units, comma groups, words, one of, dates, versions). Green: 73 passed. Red again on purpose, one rule undone at a time and restored: scope 2 failed, 22k 2, trailing zeros 1, words unread 5, one of 1, period date anywhere 1, versions unread 1. npx vitest run scripts/changes/ src/core/changes/: 14 files, 250 passed. node scripts/ci-hygiene.mjs clean.

Replay of the seven published digests (git show origin/changes-data:<id>.json) with their included pull requests (title and today's body cut at 4,000 characters, so a body edited after its run cannot be ruled out) and their own sources: 2026-10-14, 10-15, 10-16, 10-16-2, 10-19 and 11-02 admit; 2026-10-26 beat 0 is refused for "Two" ("Two changes this week.", a count of the digest's own changes, refs none). Left to the owner; the rule was not weakened. Study probes: 22,000 for 22k, 9:00 for 09:00 and 1.5 for 1.50 now pass; twelve, v2 in a period ending on the 2nd, 26 readings in one starting on the 26th, six services and 30 percent in a week ending 30 October are now refused.

activity.summary: Opened and claimed for PR P1-B of the RISE Changes v2 Phase 1 plan (owner-approved): the number rule refused #765's 22k as 22000 on 2026-11-02 and admitted spelled-out and period-date numbers no pull request states.
Number rule built on the branch: scoped to cited pull requests, exact values in digits or words, period dates only as dates; one published beat refused, left to the owner

summary: The number rule reads each beat against the pull requests it cites, compares numbers by exact value in digits or words, and admits a date of the period only as a date.
